governance.decisionForum: King’s Edge Programme Board and relevant student-experience governance, with escalation to the Portfolio Board where material investment or institutional change is required
governance.decisionScope: Approve the emerging King’s purpose and self-direction model, the basis and selection of deep trailblazer work, material choices about student-journey and role architecture, portability conclusions, and the elements proposed for institutional adoption through staff practice and the Digital Student Experience Hub.
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: Mobilisation will determine the enduring ownership of the purpose and self-direction model across Enrichment & Enhancement, Careers, student-success and other relevant student-facing functions. King’s Canvas should be sustained through the Digital Student Experience Hub rather than as a separate product.
